evidence: The phases of as-prepared SnO2 nanotubes were examined by x-ray diffraction (XRD, M18XHF-SRA, MAC Science Co.). The morphology was observed by optical microscopy, field emission scanning electron microscopy (FE-SEM, JSM6330F, JEOL) and high resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM, JEM-3000F, JEOL). The developed SnO2 nanotubes were further characterized by transmission electron microscopy (TEM) after ultrasonically dispersing them on a carbon grid.
